---
title: Rice Arancine
id: MAR-0016
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 6
time_min: 55
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g of rice
- 150 g of pea
- 200 g of ragù
- 80 g of breadcrumbs
- 60 g of all-purpose flour
- 40 g of butter
- 40 g of Grana Padano
- 0.5 sachet of saffron
- 2 egg
- to taste frying oil,
- to taste salt and pepper,
## Method
1. Bring 5 dl of lightly salted water to a boil and pour in the rice and peas.
2. Cook, stirring often with a wooden spoon, adding more boiling water as needed.
3. Remove the rice when al dente, which should have absorbed all the water.
4. Add the butter, cheese, saffron, and one egg, mixing well; season with salt and pepper.
5. When the rice has cooled slightly, shape the arancine; form a central cavity, fill with the ragù, and close, pressing the rice lightly between your hands.
6. Dredge the arancine in flour, then in beaten egg, and finally in breadcrumbs.
7. Fry them in oil, browning evenly, drain, and place on paper towels.
